title: Kelley Jones
description: "I've always found Grand Moff Tarkin's relationship with Darth Vader to be interesting," notes Kelley Jones. "They obviously have a certain respect for each other in a no-nonsense kind of way. Peter Cushing was fabulous as Tarkin and is a great subject to draw." Jones' sophisticated linework has been dazzling fans for a number of years. In the 1980's he rendered a pair of DEADMAN series for Mike Baron over at DC. More recently he's illustrated DARK JOKER (also for DC) and the five-part ALIENS: HIVE for Dark Horse. Jones also contributed ten sequential images based on the classic horror film THE MUMMY for Topps' UNIVERSAL MONSTERS ILLUSTRATED trading card set.
